title: Pit Stop
physical_identity: Infinite abandoned rustic restaurant rooms with cracked brick, flaking wallpaper, thick dust, creaking floors, and shafts of sunlight from an unseen source.
scale_topology: Infinite set of segmented indoor rooms joined by corridors; Safe Room is the sole entry; rooms reshuffle between visits.
lighting_sound: Eerily quiet, no light hum or machinery; damp 21 C; sunbeams from unseen angles.

signature_mechanic: A quiet safe pit stop where rooms silently reshuffle and a hidden random timer returns you to where you came from.
do_not: Do not add entities or chasers; the level has no signs of life.
Do not add Almond Water or Backrooms foods.
Do not add ordinary exit doors or let the player choose to leave.
Do not allow re-entry after leaving.
Do not show a visible sun or windows; the light source is imperceptible.
Do not treat the narrator's memory scenes as article fact (TESTIMONY/fiction).
Do not add hum or machinery sounds; silence is the identity.
conflicts_notes: Narrative sections are fiction/TESTIMONY. Link list maps the phrase 'enjoy the sunset' to /level-55. Survival class placeholders are unrendered.
